exam_name: Cuerpo Administrativo de la Administración del Estado

testing_centers.provider: INAP — Instituto Nacional de Administración Pública
Regional Government / Municipal Exam Centers (varies by convocatoria)

id_requirements: Valid Spanish DNI (Documento Nacional de Identidad) or NIE + supporting ID
exam_rules: Pen-and-paper, written multiple-choice (tipo test) and/or practical exercises. No mobile phones, calculators, or study materials. Negative marking: -0.33 per wrong answer (varies by convocatoria). Answer blank = 0 marks.
renewal_options: Funcionarios de carrera have permanent status; no expiry. Continuing education (formación continua) available but not mandatory for retention.

prerequisites.description: Bachillerato (Upper Secondary) or FP Grado Medio; Spanish nationality; age 16+; no criminal record

retake_policy.notes: One official call (convocatoria) per year per body; no limit on attempts across years until age limit

domains.name: Spanish Constitutional Law and Administrative Organization (Constitución, LRJSP, Statute of the Administration)
Administrative Procedure, Public Employment, Budgets, Contracting (Ley 39/2015, EBEP, LCSP)
Spanish Language: Spelling, Drafting Administrative Documents

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the Cuerpo Administrativo de la Administración del Estado exam by Oposiciones Spain covering 5 core domains.
editorial.overview: The Cuerpo Administrativo de la Administración del Estado certification program is managed by Oposiciones Spain to evaluate candidates across 5 core domains. These domains cover administrative topics including constitutional law, administrative procedures, information technology systems, European Union policies, and Spanish language spelling and document drafting skills necessary for public service roles.
editorial.who_should_take: Candidates seeking administrative roles within the Spanish State Administration should take this exam. It requires preparation across public law, IT systems, European institutions, and document drafting.
editorial.preparation_strategy: To prepare for this certification exam, candidates must review Spanish constitutional law, administrative procedures, and official European Union institutions. Furthermore, you should dedicate significant time to practicing the drafting of administrative documents in Spanish while studying information technology regulations, office software systems, and cybersecurity principles.

domain_guidance.summary: This specific domain covers Spanish Constitutional Law and Administrative Organization, including an examination of the Constitución, the LRJSP framework, and the Statute of the Administration to ensure legal compliance.

This specific domain focuses on Administrative Procedure, Public Employment regulations, Budgets, and public Contracting protocols under Ley 39/2015, the EBEP framework, and the LCSP legislation for public sector employees.

This specific technical domain addresses Information Technology topics including Office 365 utilization, LOPD and RGPD data protection mandates, e-Government digital service delivery platforms, and cybersecurity practices required in public offices.

This specific international domain examines the European Union regarding its governing institutions, treaties, and cooperative policy initiatives that impact national administrative procedures and public sector legal frameworks across member states.

This specific linguistic domain extensively tests Spanish Language proficiency regarding fundamental spelling rules, grammatical correctness, and the formal drafting procedures required for official administrative documents within state administration public offices.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your 90 minutes carefully across all 100 questions during the exam session. Ensure you have reviewed all official identification requirements before starting your application process at the designated testing center location.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The official exam contains a total of 100 questions covering 5 distinct domains of law, technology, European policies, and Spanish language skills to assess candidate competency during the evaluation.

The established passing score required to successfully clear the Cuerpo Administrativo de la Administración del Estado certification evaluation is precisely 5 points according to official guidelines provided by the administrators.
The official exam duration is strictly 90 minutes, giving candidates a limited time frame to complete and submit all 100 questions successfully before the timer expires during the testing session.

The standard exam application price notes are €18.06, which is approximately equivalent to $20 USD per individual application submitted through the designated official processing channels managed by the organization.

methodology.summary: This page was built using verified facts derived directly from official Oposiciones Spain study documentation and official BOE legislation sources to ensure maximum accuracy.
